div.ab: Gif se sconca bið þyrel beneoðan cneowe, þær sculon XII scll' to bote.
Gif se sconca bið þyrel beneoðan cneowe, ðær sculon XII scill. to bote.
Si crus transforetur alicui sub genu, duodecim sol. emendetur.
Gif se sconca bið þyrel beneoðan cneowe, ðær sculon XII scill to bote.
If the lower leg is pierced below the knee, 12 shillings shall be the compensation.
If the shin is pierced below the knee, 12 shillings must be paid as compensation for it.
Wenn der Schenkel unterhalb des Knies durchstochen ist, da gehören 12 Schill. zur Busse.
If the shank below the knee is pierced, 12 shillings are due as compensation.
